title: feat(app-shell): a create with no named package asks to pick or create one
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao2kRNNd8UR35wDQqCUcVVEy)_

Fixes #38149
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在设置、应用工作室和业务应用里新建任何东西时,如果地址里没有指定包,控制台会先弹窗让他选一个可写的包或新建一个包,选完才保存;以前这类新建会静默地存成不属于任何包的条目。
- 这是「应用工作室」第四阶段的第一步:让每个新建的条目都归属到一个包里,方便之后按包导出和删除。
- 出错时最坏的情况是某个新建入口多弹一次选包窗口或没有弹窗;取消一定什么都不写,改动只在控制台,可以直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

A create whose address names no package now asks the person to pick a package or create one, before anything is written (ADR-0070 D3, ADR-0084's amendment of 2026-11-26). One dialog (`PackageCreateAsk.tsx`) serves every create path. It offers the packages the server says this caller may write (`writable: true` on `GET /api/v1/packages`), never a kernel package. Its "New package…" button reuses the Packages page's create dialog. Cancel writes nothing.

| Path | Before | Now |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Setup list, scoped by the list's own heuristic pick | create opened in the guessed package | asks, with the guess pre-selected |
| Setup list, `?package=` the person named (link or scope selector) | create there | unchanged, no ask |
| Setup catalog (`?scope=environment`): positions, permission sets (Q-a, answered A) | live, package-less create | asks; draft in the chosen package, then its publish |
| Studio's cross-package leg (`/studio/~all/metadata/TYPE`) | create in the first package | asks, nothing pre-selected |
| Item editor deep link `/…/TYPE/new` with no `?package=` | draft naming no package (or live for `createLive`) | Save asks first; draft + publish in the answer; the item opens under it |
| New view / new report in an app whose package cannot be had | saved naming no package, plus a "saved outside this app" toast | asks |
| …in a system app (Q-b, answered C) | saved naming no package | refused with the reason (a view: My views or a business app; a report: a business app) |
| …where the ensure door refuses the caller (`403`) | saved naming no package | refused with the door's reason |
| Console create-app route (`/apps/:app/create-app`) | `saveItem('app')` naming no package | asks, then draft + publish in the answer |
| Datasource Sync | client `object-draft` read, then a package-less client save | the server's import door, which lands the object in the datasource's package (ruling B) |

The open readings I picked:

- **The repair's own-write marker.** The list's `?package=` repair now writes the location-state key `objectui.packagePicked` beside the address it repaired. A `?package=` is *named* only when that mark is absent or names a different package. A link and the scope selector write no state, so they stay named. The list's own address writers carry the state through.
- **The console create-app route.** A thin wrapper, `ConsoleCreateAppPage`, keeps the plugin-designer wizard. `CreateAppPage` gains an optional `saveApp(name, app)`; the wrapper asks, then saves as Studio's new-app door does (first-write-pinned draft, then that one item's publish).
- **The datasource sync landing.** `POST /api/v1/datasources/:name/external/tables/:remote/import`. It is the same external-datasource service as `remote-tables` and `object-draft`, and Sync is offered only on a federation source.

The Q-a premise was measured first, as a real kernel test, before any UI was built (`position-in-package-binds-outside-sets-38149.dogfood.test.ts`, kept in this PR). The setup:

- a showcase boot;
- two writable runtime packages;
- a position created into one of them through the editor's own REST doors (`PUT ?mode=draft&package=`, then `POST …/publish?package=`);
- bound to four sets: one in its own package, one in the other package, one the showcase ships, and one loose set.

Result: 4/4 green. The holder is granted all four sets. A live package-less edit of a set lands on the package's own row. A set the position does not name is not granted. The ablation is in Tests.

The editor holds the chosen package for the form; it never writes it into the address before the save. Measured live: on the `~all` leg, a `?package=` written first moved the page into the package's area and remounted the form mid-save.

Not in this PR, as the dispatch ordered:

- No `docs/adr/**` edit. What 9's marks go to the kernel-close card.
- No server file and no `packages/spec`.
- The `view.savedOutsideApp` / `report.builder.savedOutsideApp` i18n keys are kept, only unused.

Surface beyond the claim, each a one-line consequence:

- `packages-io.ts`: the ensure door's error carries `status`.
- `ObjectView.tsx`: renders the ask's dialog.
- `ConsoleCreateAppPage.tsx`: new.
- `AppContent.tsx`: the create-app chunk.
- `plugin-designer/src/index.tsx`: the type export.

## Tests

All are run at the final head, one union run. The figures are in Verification.

- New:
  - `PackageCreateAsk-38149`: list filter, pre-select, Continue gate, Cancel once, New package answers and returns, failed read, a second ask answers the first `null`.
  - `ResourceListPage.createAsk-38149`: arrival repair asks with the pick pre-selected; Cancel; a `?package=` arrival and a selector choice skip the ask; New disabled while packages load; catalog asks and keeps the scope; the `~all` leg asks.
  - `ResourceEditPage.createAsk-38149`: deep-link Cancel writes nothing; position and permission set get draft + publish in the answer and land under it; a named-package control; a refused first save keeps the form and the answer, and the retry asks nothing.
  - `runtime-metadata-persistence.createAsk-38149`: every resolve outcome, the pick, the cancel, and the no-app control.
  - `ConsoleCreateAppPage.createAsk-38149`: ask, then draft under the first-write pin, then publish; Cancel writes nothing.
  - `ReportNewPage-36692`, three new cases: unlisted app asks; cancel; system app refused, with the ensure door never asked.
  - `objectViewViewSharing`: a cancelled ask writes and says nothing.
  - The dogfood probe above.
- Retargeted pins of the retired package-less create. Each now pins the ask, the refusal, or a named package:
  - `liveCreate-7611`, `positionCreateLive-26192`, `walledFallback-35624`, `otherTypesUntouched-35624`, `createIntoApp-35624`, `saveAndPublishIntoApp-36409`, `sameAddress-35624`, `ReportNewPage-36692` (both ensure-refusal controls), `syncNextSteps-30328` (import door), `pairCreate-36897`;
  - and nine editor create tests that now name their package in the address;
  - four view-create tests: the auth fetch reaches the page's package stub, and the save names `demo`.

## Acceptance notes

- `createLive` (permission, position) is now unreachable from the editor's create: every create names a package. The key is registered in `builtinComponents.tsx` and `registry.ts`, outside this card's surface. Retiring it is a narrowing, left for a follow-up.
- The two `savedOutsideApp` keys are unused now and kept, as ordered. Retiring them is a second, narrowing PR.
- The ask's pre-select uses the list's heuristic pick and never takes it as the answer. A read-only base appears only once its `.custom` pair is a listed writable package. A base with no pair is not offered.
- A view or report ask is titled "Choose a package". The Setup list and editor asks name the type ("Which package should this Position go in?").
- The AI create path (cloud) is not in this card.
- Out of scope, found live (reported, not fixed here): the Setup access directory blanks a create. Steps: Setup → Positions and Permissions → New, then choose a package. Measured result: `…/component/security/access-directory/position/new?scope=environment&package=…` renders an empty page. The shell rewrites `/apps/setup/…` to `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/…`. `AccessDirectoryPage` slices its rest only off `/apps/setup/…`, so its `/new` redirect to Studio never runs. The same `./new` navigation existed before this PR.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `ResourceListPage.tsx` `handleCreate`: which create asks and which goes straight through.
2. `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts` `resolveRuntimeCreatePackage`: refused versus ask.
3. `ResourceEditPage.tsx` `doSave`: the ask, and the held answer.

Two-minute check: boot a showcase, create one writable package, then open `/studio/~all/metadata/dashboard` and press New. The dialog lists only that writable package, and Continue stays disabled until it is chosen.

Screenshots (light and dark, desktop 1440 and phone 390) are in the project files under `objectstack-seat3/shots-38149/`, 16 PNGs:

- the Setup catalog's ask (Positions);
- the `~all` leg's ask (Dashboard);
- an app's Add view ask (a package-less app);
- a new report's ask.

Live, on the same boot: the editor's ask on the `~all` leg answered `PUT …/position/field_dispatcher?mode=draft&package=com.acme.field-ops` 200, then `POST …/publish?package=com.acme.field-ops` 200. It landed on `/studio/com.acme.field-ops/metadata/position/field_dispatcher`. The read answered `_packageId: com.acme.field-ops`.
